Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The System Event message is used to signal key market or data feed control events.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Denotes the type of event for which the message is being generated.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, NASDAQ PSX disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in its market center system.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue for which the directory message is being generated.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Denotes the listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: For NASDAQ-listed issues, this field indicates when a firm is not in compliance with NASDAQ continued listing requirements.

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ OMX uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: NASDAQ-assigned indicator for issue for which the stock trading action message is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the issue.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reflects the Market Ops or MarketWatch code for the trading state change.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction (Rule 201) status for an issue: a full pre-opening spin for NASDAQ-listed issues and intraday status changes.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: Quotation Message
Message.Description: PSX BBO will broadcast a real-time update every time that the exchange's best bid and offer quote is updated during the trading day.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the PSX market center system issue identifier for which the PSX BBO quotation message is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the stock.

Field.Name: PSX Best Bid Price
Field.Description: Denotes the PSX best bid price, the highest price for market buy order(s) in the PSX system. Price format is $$$$$$dddd.

Field.Name: PSX Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the PSX market center system at the PSX best bid Price.

Field.Name: PSX Best Offer Price
Field.Description: Denotes the PSX exchange's best offer price, the lowest price for market sell order(s) in the PSX system. Price format is $$$$$$dddd.

Field.Name: PSX Best Offer Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the PSX market center system at the PSX Best Offer Price.

Value.Name: Start of Transmissions
Value.Description: Denotes that PSX BBO has started its daily transmission schedule.

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: This message indicates that PSX is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: It indicates that PSX is now closed and will not accept any new orders today.

Value.Name: End of Transmissions
Value.Description: Denotes that PSX BBO has completed its daily transmission schedule.

Value.Name: Emergency Market Condition Halt
Value.Description: This message is sent to inform PSX market participants that the EMC is in effect. No trading is allowed during the EMC.

Value.Name: Emergency Market Condition Quote Only Period
Value.Description: This message is sent to inform PSX market participants that the EMC quotation only period is in effect.

Value.Name: Emergency Market Condition Resumption
Value.Description: This message is sent to inform PSX market participants that EMC is no longer in effect.
